title: DLO-Lab: Benchmarking Deformable Linear Object Manipulations with Differentiable Physics
tldr: [Research Paper] This work introduces DLO-Lab, a differentiable physics simulator and benchmark suite designed to address the challenges of manipulating deformable linear objects like ropes and cables. The framework enables versatile material modeling and policy learning through a specialized agent that handles topological complexity and strategic grasping, with successful sim-to-real transfer demonstrated.
